This package contains the following third-party components. They remain

FFmpeg 8.1.2
------------
The Windows x64 executables are the GyanD essentials build of FFmpeg 8.1.2,
built from FFmpeg commit 38b88335f99e76ed89ff3c93f877fdefce736c13.
The distributed build is licensed under GPL version 3. The package contains
the build provider's license and build notes, the corresponding official
FFmpeg source archive, and its upstream signature under third_party/ffmpeg.
FFmpeg project: https://ffmpeg.org/
Binary provider: https://github.com/GyanD/codexffmpeg/releases/tag/8.1.2
Source: https://ffmpeg.org/releases/ffmpeg-8.1.2.tar.xz

Copyright (c) the ggml authors. whisper.cpp is licensed under the MIT License.
The license and pinned source archive are under third_party/whisper.cpp.
Project: https://github.com/ggml-org/whisper.cpp

Whisper ggml-small-q5_1 model
-----------------------------
The quantized multilingual model is distributed from the whisper.cpp model
repository and is based on OpenAI Whisper. The applicable MIT license notice
is under third_party/whisper-model.
Model: https://huggingface.co/ggerganov/whisper.cpp
Original project: https://github.com/openai/whisper

Exact versions, source revisions, download locations, and archive hashes are
recorded in third_party/versions.json. Hashes of the files shipped in this
skill are recorded in third_party/checksums.sha256.
